capsule_format.finding: the ASUS .CAP is a 2,048-byte wrapper before the 16 MiB ROM (16,779,264 = 2,048 + 16,777,216)
capsule_format.proof: first nesting-rule-valid FV sits at 0x40800 in the CAP and 0x40000 in the sliced ROM — the delta equals the wrapper exactly (both 4655 and 3604)
capsule_format.wrapper_ascii: no ASCII signature in the wrapper head (recorded verbatim in the scratch register); the wrapper is data, not text
capsule_format.consequence: the day-0 dump (a raw SPI read) is compared against the SLICED rom, never against the CAP

the_3644_question.fact: no BIOS 3644 exists in the official ASUS PRIME B450-PLUS ledger (39 entries checked; the series jumps 3604 (2022-03-16) to 3802 (2022-05-12)); the TUF B450-PLUS GAMING ledger shows no 3644 either (latest 4645, 2026-02-02)
hypotheses: misread of 3604 (digit transposition on the boot splash) — most economical
a different board than recorded in the study
a non-stock BIOS on the day-0 board
